Get Spam-Free Term Insurance Advice
Is term insurance a complete waste of money because you get ₹0 back if you survive? In this video, we do a real side-by-side mathematical calculation comparing a ₹1 Crore Term Insurance plan with an Equity Mutual Fund SIP.
We break down the numbers over a 40-year period, analyze what happens to your family in Year 1 vs Year 10, and explain why mixing investment with protection is one of the biggest financial mistakes you can make.
